ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Shield settings look normal, but something feels off. Compare the live file to the backup by hash, confirm they differ, then restore the clean copy.

1. certutil -hashfile shield-live.cfg SHA256
2. certutil -hashfile backup\shield-live.cfg.bak SHA256
3. copy backup\shield-live.cfg.bak shield-live.cfg

steps.title: Compare hashes
steps.body: Volt: "Hashes don't lie. If they don't match, something changed." Hash both the live file and the backup, and compare them: `certutil -hashfile shield-live.cfg SHA256`, then `certutil -hashfile backup\shield-live.cfg.bak SHA256`. Look closely at the arc setting at the end of the live file — that's the change.

steps.title: Restore the clean copy
steps.body: Rivet: "Found the tamper. Now undo it." Restore the backup over the live file: `copy backup\shield-live.cfg.bak shield-live.cfg`.

objectives.label: shield-live.cfg matches the clean backup again
